title: NeMo Evaluation Run — CLI Input
description: Documents the three inputs the external CLI passes to run_eval.py. Judge LLM configuration lives in the pipeline YAML, not here.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the agent's OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. http://localhost:8080/v1

pipeline.description: Filename of a NeMo pipeline YAML in pipelines/, e.g. custom_qa_judge.yaml

dataset.description: Path to a test case JSON file. Defaults to datasets/sample_cases.json if omitted.

x-env-vars.description: Passed as environment variables — present in the execution environment automatically. Model names follow LiteLLM format (same as NAT).
x-env-vars.AGENT_API_KEY: API key for the agent endpoint
x-env-vars.AGENT_MODEL_NAME: LiteLLM model name the agent endpoint expects (e.g. openai/gpt-4o)
x-env-vars.LITELLM_PROXY_URL: URL of the LiteLLM proxy — judge calls are routed through this. Present in the environment at execution time.
x-env-vars.MAX_CONCURRENCY: Optional. Parallel requests to the agent (default: 4)

x-pipeline-model-names.description: Model names in pipeline YAMLs (judge.model) use LiteLLM format — the same convention NAT uses. Examples: openai/gpt-4o-mini, anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, nvidia_nim/meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct
